description.value:
A hardlight musician manifests above the battlefield, their music tugging at the heartstrings of everyone around them. If you are the prima donna, the emanation's radius is doubled. Attempt a single Performance check against the Will DC of each enemy in the area. No matter the outcome, the creature becomes immune to Starsong Recital for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the musician for 1 minute (even if it moves). A fascinated creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to creatures that aren't under a spotlighted, and must either Step or Stride toward the musician as their first action. The condition ends if you use a hostile action against the target, but not if a creature uses a hostile action against its allies.

Success As critical success, but at the end of each round the fascinated creature can attempt a Will save, ending the effect on a success.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts for 1 round.

Heightened (6th) Increase emanation radius to 30 feet.

Heightened (9th) Increase emanation radius to 120 feet.
